tei:div.tei:p: "!#༈ thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi las byang tshogs gnyis spungs pa bzhugs so:1$0000250 badz+ra bho tra'i gter ma/1$0000300

thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas: mchod gtor rim pa bya ba ni: rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bshams te: khri'u dang mañdzi'i khar bzhag ste: rang stan bde ba la 'dug ste: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba 'di lan gsum bya'o: hrī: bdag gzhan bla med rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: chos sku lnga ldan bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bdag gzhan bla med rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: longs sku thugs rje chen po'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o: bdag gzhan bla med rdzogs sangs= dpal chen rta mgrin drag po'i lha la skyabs su mchi'o: bdag gzhan= gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o: bdag gzhan= sprul sku rgyal sras pad+ma'i sku la skyabs= bdag gzhan= chos skyong srung ma gter bdag rnams la skyabs su= bdag gzhan= chos mdzad mched lcam sgrub mdzad rnams la= gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bdag gis 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rig drug pha ma sdug bsngal bskyab bya'i phyir: theg mchog 'dir zhugs thugs rje chen po bsgrub: sgra dbyangs ma ṇis sems can skyob byed cing: tshad med bzhi yis chos kyi rmang btings te: smon 'jug gnyis kyis lag len gnad sbyangs nas: rig drug pha ma sbyin pa gsum gyis bskyab: sku gsum 'bras bu thob par sems bskyed do: gsum pa tshogs gsag pa ni: dngos 'byor yid sprul maṇ+ḍal bshams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: byams sems snying rje'i maṇ+ḍal gzhi ma la: bskyed rdzogs zhi lhag nyams rtogs tshom bu bkram: stong gsal 'gag med gang snang longs spyod 'thibs: thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i lha tshogs mchod: gser gyi sa gzhi 'byung lnga brtsegs pa'i steng: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas brgyan: bye ba phrag brgya stong gsum 'bras bu brtsegs:

'phrul dga'i 'dod yon mchod sprin sna tshogs gtibs: sku gsum zhing khams bkod pa khyad 'phags 'di: thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rjes bzhes la bdag gi shes rgyud khrol: ji srid 'gro drug bla med ma thob bar: thar pa bsgrub la bar gcod mi 'byung zhing: thugs rje'i lha dang dbyer med sangs rgyas te: khams gsum sems can sku gsum thob par shog: bzhi pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: mdun du kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum bsam: de'i steng du rang gi thugs kha nas: a dkar po 'phros: gtor ma sman raka dang bcas pa la phog: 'od du zhu ba las: ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba: stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du: sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng na: snying po lnga bsam la: gtor ma'i zhabs su: rang gi thugs ka nas yaṃ 'phros pas rlung byung bas raṃ las me sbar: thod rdzas zhu zhing khol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzhi brjod pas dang pos sku'i bdud rtsi dkar mer gyis gang bar bsam: gnyis pas gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar mer gyis gang bar bsam: gsum pas thugs kyi bdud rtsi sngon pos gang bar bsam: bzhi pas bdud rtsi kha dog lnga ldan ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa: ro sbrang rtsi skol ba lta bur gyur par bsam mo: lnga pa bka' bsgo mtshams gcad pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: hrī: nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te: rta skad rngam 'tsher bar chad sel: sku las 'od zer bar gcod btul: me ri rdo rje'i rwa bas phyogs mtshams chod: bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med: ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can la: lha dang 'dre bgegs gnyis snang yang: sems nyid ye grol spros med la: 'dre bgegs zhes pa ga la srid: rnam rtog gnyis 'dzin bgegs su shar: bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs: stong gsal ngang du mtshams chod cig:

hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: de rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i le'u dang po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni: oṃ: byams pa tshad med ngang las ni: ā: dga' ba tshad med 'ja' sprin 'khrigs: hūm̐: sprul sku'i snying rjes kun la khyab: hrī: sku lnga rdzogs pa'i ngo bor bsam: de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas: 'phags pa mchod nas snod la phog: gzhal yas khang du lam mer bsam: tshur 'dus bdag lus rnam smin bsregs: rang rig nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: skad cig thugs rje chen po'i sku: dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: dang po gnyis ni thugs kar thal mo sbyar: g.yas 'og pad rāg phreng ba 'dren: g.yon 'og me tog yu ba 'dzin: skyil krung rin chen dar gyis brgyan: dbu skra thor tshugs gyen du brdzes: dar gyi cod pan ze prog can: gsal la dngos po med par bskyed: g.yas su mi ro nyi zla'i steng: yi dam rta mgrin khros pa'i rgyal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: g.yas pas gser gyi ḍā ru 'khrol: g.yon pas dngul gyi dril bu gsil: dbu gtsug rta mgo phyogs bcur 'tsher: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus na 'gying: rus rgyan gar stabs shigs se bsgom: g.yon du mi ro nyi zla'i steng: yum chen gsang ye sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig mche gtsigs spyan gsum ma: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag: rus pa'i rgyan drug gar stabs can: ā ral+li yi sgra sgrog cing: spyi gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra 'byin: dpa' mo rgya mtshos bskor bar bsgom: de yi spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng: bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas ni: sku mdog mthing nag gzi brjid ldan: a tsar cha byad rus rgyan can: g.yas pas seng ldeng cang te'u 'khrol: g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu gsil: gzhon tshul gar stabs 'od zer 'khyil: bla ma rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs: de yi rgyab phyogs thams cad na: chos skyong srung ma rgya mtsho dang:

dam can gter bdag rgya mtsho rnams: thams cad phrin las tshul bzhin byed: 'od zer skar ltar 'khrugs par bsam: gdong du rig drug sems can rnams: ma ṇi'i sgra dbyangs ldir bar bsam: de ltar ma yengs gsal gdab bo: de nas gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas te 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: badz+ra gu ru ha ya grī wa dhu ma gha ye ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīng hrīng: zhes brgya stong gis nyams skyong zhing: hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: sku mdog mthing nag gar stabs can: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: bsil ba tshal du yon tan brnyes: pad+ma saṃ bha gshegs su gsol: ri bo ta lar shes bya brnyes: blo ldan mchog sred gshegs su gsol: o rgyan yul du rgyal srid bskyangs: pad+ma rgyal po gshegs= ma ga ta ru rdzu 'phrul brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer gshegs= rdo rje gdan du bstan pa gsos: shākya seṅge gshegs= a su rar byon mu stegs btul: seṅge sgra sgrog gshegs= bod kyi yul byon gter gyis bkang: rdo rje gro lod gshegs= srin po'i yul byon chos kyis bskyangs: pad+ma thod phreng gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ri bo ta la'i zhing khams nas: byang sems snying rje brtse ba'i bdag: thugs rje chen po 'gro drug skyabs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs chos 'byung gdan steng nas: rngam pa'i nga ros bgegs 'dul gtso: dpal chen rta mgrin 'jigs pa'i sku: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs= dur khrod gnas brgyad ro steng nas: khro tshul chags pa gzhon tshul can: gsang ye yum chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol:

bla ma rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: rgyal ba rgya mtsho= dpa' bo rgya mtsho= mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho= chos skyong rgya mtsho= gter bdag rgya mtsho= gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: sku gsung thugs kyi byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes spyan drang ngo: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: stong gsum gzhal yas yangs pa'i nang: rin chen sna lnga seṅge'i khri: nyi zla pad+ma dar zab steng: rgyal sras pad+ma thod phreng dang: bla ma rgya mtsho ma lus kun: gzi brjid 'dzum pas bzhugs su gsol: thugs rje chen po byams mgon dang: rgyal ba rgya mtsho bzhugs su gsol: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po dang: dpa' bo rgya mtsho bzhugs su gsol: mkha' 'gro gsang ye gtso mo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bzhugs su gsol: chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang: gter bdag rgya mtsho ma lus rnams: gzi brjid 'dzum pas bzhugs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib sbyong phyir: bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams: bla ma rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: thugs rje rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: brgyad yod de: maṇ+ḍal: phyi mchod: nang mchod: gsang mchod: sman mchod: rak+ta: gtor ma: dug lnga'o: dang po maṇ+ḍal 'bul: gnyis pa phyi mchod ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: hrī: stong khams 'di 'am gzhan dag na: shes byas bsdus dang ma bsdus pa'i: me tog bdug spos mar me dang: zhal zas sgra snyan yid 'ong rnams: rgyal sras o rgyan yab yum dang: bla ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dpal chen rta mgrin lha tshogs dang: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba ye shes gtso mo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dang: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: phyi yi mchod par bzhes nas kyang: bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs sdig sgrib sbyang bar mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhai: nai wid+yā: shab+da: pū tsa ho: zhes 'phul lo: gsum pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hrī: dbang po lnga yi me tog gsur chen spos: rkang gling rnga sgra zhun chen me: dri chen zhal zas dri chu'i skyems: dug gsum sku gsum phyi yi gar: dug lnga ye shes lngar bsgyur te: pad+ma thod phreng lha tshogs dang: bla ma rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: dpal chen rta mgrin lha tshogs dang: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: gsang ba ye shes gtso mo dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dang: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: nang gi mchod par bzhes nas kyang: rigs drug rang sems rtogs par mdzod: bzhi pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang ba yab kyi thabs mchog dang: stong pa yum gyi shes rab sbyar: mkha' gsang gnyis med sbyar ba yi: thig le dkar dmar byang sems rgyun: bde ba'i ro snyoms zag med de: gsal stong snang stong rig stong dang:

bde stong dran stong mchod par 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: dga' bzhi zhen med bzhes nas kyang: rgyu drug bdag gzhan sems can gyi: zag bcas 'khor ba'i rgyud dag nas: zag med sku gsum thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: lnga pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni: ka pā la btegs te: hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: sman gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rtsa ba brgyad la lo ma stong: tshogs brgyad nyon mongs stong dag phyir: ra sa ya na a mṛ ta: yon tan bsam 'das mchod pa ni: bla ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: thugs rje rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes mdzod la: grol dus med pa'i gzung 'dzin phrol: chod dus med pa'i zhen pa chod: rang gsal chos nyid don rtog shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes mtshan re re bzhin du 'bul lo: drug pa rak+ta 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: 'khor ba bsgral pa'i bhan+dha ru: nga bdag bsgral pa'i khrag gis bkang: 'dod chags bsgral pa'i rba klong la: zhe sdang bsgral pa'i lhu dum 'phyo: gti mug bsgral pa'i zhag chen 'khyil: skye shi rtsad gcod rak+ta 'di: chags med yum gyi mkha' las babs: bla ma rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rje rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes mdzod la: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa dang: byang chub myur du thob par mdzod:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma ha rak+ta khā hi: bdun pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du: khams gsum rigs drug gtor mar bshams: bya spyod sna tshogs gtor rgyan spras: rnam shes 'gyu rtog sman raka bran: skye med chig chod gur chen phub: nyams myong rtog pa'i ro mchog bda': bdud rtsi 'dod yon 'byor ldan 'dis: bla ma rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rje rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes mdzod la: dbang dang dngos grub mchog thun stsol: rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams: ye grol gzhi yi don rtogs nas: rang grol lam gyi tshogs rdzogs te: lhun grub 'bras bu'i gding lon shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes mtshan re re bzhin 'bul lo: brgyad pa dug lnga ye shes su 'bul ba ni:

hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: dug lnga rang grol mchod pa ni: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can gyi: gti mug chos dbyings ngang du 'bul: rig stong chen po'i don rtogs shog: zhe sdang rdo rje'i rigs la 'bul: gsal stong me long don rtogs shog: nga rgyal rin chen rigs la 'bul: grags stong mnyam nyid don rtogs shog: 'dod chags pad+ma'i rigs la 'bul: bde stong sor rtog don rtogs shog: phrag dog las kyi rigs la 'bul: dran stong bya grub don rtogs shog: dug lnga ye shes rang byung 'dis: bla ma rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rje rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs mchod: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes mdzod la: skye med zhi gnas brtan pa dang: 'gag med lhag mthong gsal ba dang: dbyer med zang thal ngang gnas shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā pañtsa pū tsa ho: dz+nyā na sarba pū dza ho: zhes lha re re'am: spyir dril te 'bul: bstod pa la drug yod pa'i dang po bla ma rgya mtsho la bstod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi na mo hūm̐: hrī: pad+ma las 'khrungs yab yum rus ma skyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnas lnga kun sbyangs byang sems thugs rjer ldan: pad+ma sam+bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs zhal mjal yon tan kun tu rgyas: blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag= rgyal po'i srid bzung 'gro kun chos la btsud: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag= skye 'gro'i sgrib sbyangs rig 'dzin bzhi po thob: nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag= bdud bzhi btul nas bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: shākya seṅge'i sku la phyag= mu stegs btul nas ston pa'i rgyal tshab mdzad: seng ge sgra sgrog sku la phyag=

sprul pa sna tshogs bod khams chos la bkod: rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag= skye 'chi mi mnga' 'dzam gling kun tu byon: pad+ma thod phreng sku la phyag= rtsa brgyud dus gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog: bla ma rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag thams cad la: byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin phob: bdag ni khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams: khyed kyi thugs rjes bzung du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sarba sid+dhi na mo hūm̐: zhes pas bstod do: gnyis pa yi dam zhi ba thugs rje chen po la bstod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo thugs rje che: 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sku: chags med snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sku mdog dmar gsal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes bzung: zhal nas chos sgra ma ṇi'i sgra dbyangs mdzad: shangs nas rlung 'byung nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms: rig pa thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: snyan nas sgra dbyangs rigs drug 'dul thabs mdzad: sprul sku thugs rje chen po'i sku la bstod: phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med sbyor: g.yas 'og bgrang phreng byang chub lam ston bstod: g.yon 'og pad+ma 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos: skye 'chi rtsad gcod thugs rje che la bstod: zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don du mnyam par bzhugs: pha rol phyin drug thugs rje che la bstod: rus pa'i rgyan drug 'gro drug dbang du sdud: 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs 'dus bcu gcig zhal dang spyan stong sogs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams la bstod: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis dzap bstod mchod pa bzhes: khams gsum rigs drug sems can gyi: sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sku gsum thob par mdzod:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: gsum pa yi dam khro bo rta mgrin la bstod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: hrī: ye shes rig pa nyid las bskyed pa'i lha: rang byung rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje thugs khros rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag bdud bzhi btul la bstod: spyan gsum rab 'jigs sdang mig dgra la bsgrad: 'jigs byed rta mgrin dbang la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhal ni ag tshom am gtsigs mche ba gtsigs: skye 'chi rtsad gcod rta mgrin rgyal la bstod: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur tse re re: khams gsum dbang sdud rta mgrin rgyal la bstod: phyag g.yas dbang sdud seng ldeng ḍā ru 'khrol: snang ba dbang sdud rta mgrin rgyal la bstod: g.yon pas zil gnon dngul gyi dril bu gsil: 'gro drug shes grol rta mgrin rgyal la bstod: dur khrod chas brgyad mi ro'i steng na 'gying: khro chen rta mgrin rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs stag sham can: drag po rta mgrin rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs bzhi dpa' bo dregs pa kun 'dul sogs: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: dbang dang dngos grub mchog thun bstsal du gsol: 'bar ba gsum gyis sgo gsum rab khongs la: sku gsum thob pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bsdu ba bzhi yis snang srid dbang sdus la: snang srid zil gnon dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la bstod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥdhu ma gha ye ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: stong nyid dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku: ma gcig bde gshegs yum chen sku la bstod: skye 'gro kun la ma ltar brtse byed ma: thugs rje'i yum chen rnal 'byor ma la bstod:

sku mdog dmar mo dug lnga rang sar dag: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la bstod: rus pa'i rgyan drug phar phyin drug dang ldan: kun tu bzang mo yum chen sku la bstod: tshad med bzhi ldan bde ba'i gar stabs mdzad: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: dug gsum rtsad gcod phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams: rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog ma nges cha lugs cir yang sgyur: sna tshogs rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma la bstod: phyag g.yon thod khrag srid gsum ma lus 'dul: bdag med bde stong chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma la bstod: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo zlog: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: thabs shes dbyer med zhabs gnyis gar stabs mdzad: shes rab bde chen mkha' 'gro ma la bstod: bcu drug gzhon tshul khros ma 'dzum pa'i mdangs: bde gshegs mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: nam mthong dran pas zag med bde ba spor: kun bzang yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku mdog dkar mo cha lugs sna tshogs ston: rdo rje ḍā ki ma la phyag= sku mdog ser mo cha lugs sna tshogs ston: rin chen ḍā ki ma la phyag= sku mdog dmar mo cha lugs sna tshogs ston: pad+ma ḍā ki ma la phyag= sku mdog ljang gu cha lugs sna tshogs ston: karma ḍā ki ma la phyag= sku mdog ma nges cha lugs sna tshogs ston: chos dbyings ḍā ki ma la phyag= phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin bzhi la sogs: bdag cag rnams kyis thob par mdzad du gsol: rigs bzhi la sogs bye ba ther 'bum gyi: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bhud+dha ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: badz+ra ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: rat+na ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: pad+ma ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: karma ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: sarba ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: bi shwa ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: lo ka ḍā ki nī na mo hūm̐: sid+dhi ḍā ki nī hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīng hrīng:

lnga pa chos skyong rnams la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa: 'jig rten 'das kyang drag shul rngams stabs can: drag po'i cha lugs dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod: chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: drug pa gter bdag rnams la bstod pa ni: hrī: u rgyan la sogs rig 'dzin thams cad kyis: gnyer gtad lung 'dzin dam chos bya ra byed: skal ldan rnams la lung bzhin bu nor gtad: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod pa bya'o: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdag cag rig 'dzin pho mo rnams: rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can gyis: tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas: da lta'i dus 'di yan chad du: lus kyis mi dge gsum spyad cing: ngag gis mi dge bzhi dang ni: sems kyis mi dge gsum la sogs: ngan song rgyu bsags thams cad mthol lo bshags: nyan thos nyis brgya lnga bcu ste: so so thar pa'i sdom pa nyams pa dang: nang ltar gsang sngags dam tshig ste: sa ma ya ni 'bum sde nyams: gsang ba byang sems bslab pa ste: stong phrag drug sogs nyams pa dang: snod med mi la dam chos bstan: dam med mi la dbang bzhi bskur: rang sems sangs rgyas logs su bcad: 'bras bu gzhan nas re ba dang: rigs drug pha ma yin pa la: nye ring dgra gnyen bzung ba dang: chos mdzad dgongs pa gcig pa la: grub mtha' spang blang byas pa dang: bla mas ngo sprod btab gyur nas: 'jig rten bya bas tshe 'dir g.yengs: nyams len myong rtogs shor ba kun: bla ma rgya mtsho'i drung du bshags: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung du bshags: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i= mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i= chos skyong rgya mtsho'i= gter srung rgya mtsho'i drung du bshags: ces bshags: de nas dzap dbyangs bya ba ni: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde gshegs mchod:

sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: tshur 'dus lha tshogs rnams thugs dam rgyud bskul bar bsam: nyams spar zhing 'chams te: dzap dbyangs bar snang 'brug ldir ba ltar 'ur che la gdangs drag par bzla'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: badz+ra gu ru ha ya grī wa dhu ma gha ye ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīng hrīng: zhes pa bde gshegs rgya mtsho thams cad dril ba'i snying po'o: brgya stong bye ba re'i mtshams su dngos grub re len zhing: gtor tshogs re gtang ngo: dngos grub len tshig ni 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus lha tshogs la: rnal 'byor mched lcam mos gus byed: gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs: byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas zhu: lus sgrib dag nas bum dbang skur: sprul pa sku yi dngos grub zhu: ngag sgrib dag nas gsang dbang skur: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dngos grub zhu: yid sgrib dag nas tshig dbang skur: skye med chos sku thob par mdzod: thun mong tshe ring nad med dang: grub chen brgyad sogs dngos grub zhu: mthar thug dug lnga rang grol nas: ye shes lnga po rtogs par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru bla ma rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru rgyal ba rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dpa' bo rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru chos skyong rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru gter bdag rgya mtsho sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ces pas gtor ma dang bdud rtsi mgo la gtug go: ho: bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i dngos grub rnams: bsnyen sgrub sgom pa'i rig 'dzin mched lcam la: rig 'dzin bzhi yi dbang mchog da skur cig: dri ma bzhi dag ye shes rang gsal shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: dngos gzhi'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈ da ni tshogs 'bul ba ni: 'byor tshogs ci cher bshams la: hrī: bde gshegs kun 'dus lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs 'bul zhal phye zhig: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis dag par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi gtor tshogs 'di: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: gu ru pad+ma thod phreng zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: gu ru pad+ma sam+bha'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: gu ru blo ldan mchog sred zhal du= gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i= gu ru nyi ma 'od zer= gu ru shākya seng ge'i= gu ru seng ge sgra sgrog= gu ru rdo rje gro lod= gu ru rtsa ba'i bla ma'i= gu ru brgyud pa'i bla ma'i= gu ru bla ma rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: yi dam la 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal du= thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi zhal du= thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong zhal du= thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus= thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa'i= thugs rje chen po sgrib pa kun sel= thugs rje chen po ma rig mun sel= thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog= thugs rje chen po ngan song kun skyob= thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs= thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal kun sel= thugs rje chen po mtshan brgya rtsa'i= thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal du gā ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: dpa' bo rgya mtsho la 'bul ba ni: hrī: bcom ldan dpal chen rta mgrin zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: rta mgrin dregs pa'i zhal du= rta mgrin nag po'i zhal du= rta mgrin dregs pa srog 'phrog=

rta mgrin dregs pa lha lnga'i= rta mgrin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i= rta mgrin 'jigs byed gtum chen= rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul= rta mgrin spu gri'i= rdo rje ging gi= rin chen ging gi= pad+ma ging gi= karma ging gi= sna tshogs ging gi= 'jig rten ging gi= dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba ni: hrī: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du= rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= rdo rje dgyes ma'i= rdo rje dbyings phyug ma'i= rdo rje kun 'dul ma'i= bhaṃ ga la'i mkha' 'gro'i= sgrol ma jo mo'i= rdo rje kun grol ma'i= rgya mtsho gling gi mkha' 'gro'i= gangs dkar rtse'i mkha' 'gro'i= rdo rje dhā ki'i= rin chen dhā ki'i= pad+ma dhā ki'i= karma dhā ki'i= 'jig rten dhā ki'i= sha za dhā ki'i= sna tshogs dhā ki'i= mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: chos skyong la 'bul ba ni: hrī: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la kha kha khā hi: zhes pas 'bul zhing tshogs la rol par bya'o: gnyis pa lhag ma rnams bsdus la: gtor snod gcig tu bstsal te: kha phrus byin gyis brlabs la:

ho: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong dbang phyug nyi shu sogs: lhag la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro las byed rnams: 'dod yon lhag mchod dri chus brgyan pa 'di: dbang po'i yul du gang la gang 'dod 'bul: rang rang bud med gnyen 'dun dpung dang bcas: shes bya'i klong du re ba tshims gyur cig: rang rang las kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa dang: sgrub mched rnams kyi bar chad zlog pa dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bsdu ba dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dhā ki nī: rat+na dhā ki nī: sha ra na pra ti bho khā hi: zhes so/ de nas gtor ma rnams phyir btegs la: sman rak+ta bran la 'di skad do: bh+yo: thugs rje chen po'i bka' nyan tshogs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bcom ldan dpal chen rta mgrin dang: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= yum chen gsang ba ye shes dang: dpa' bo rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams: dam rdzas= bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= mgon po ma hā kā la dang: chos skyong rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams: dam rdzas= bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= rdo rje legs pa sman skyong dang: gter bdag rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams: dam rdzas= bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= rdo rje g.yu bun la sogs pa'i= bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyang: dam rdzas= bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= dge bsnyen mkha' ri la sogs pa'i: dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig kyang: dam rdzas= bcol pa'i= zlog sgyur= rgyal chen sde bzhi la sogs pa'i: gtsang rigs bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyang: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma rgyu phyogs su btang ngo: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu: lhag chad ma ṇi brgya rtsas bskang:

mad chad dkyil: bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir: sgom sgrub bsnyen pa'i byin rlabs kyis: byin rlabs nyi zla'i zer ltar shar: thugs rje chu bo'i rgyun ltar babs: khams gsum bde legs kun 'byung ba: thugs rje spyan ras gzigs kyis gtsor byas te: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng sogs: bla ma rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: bcom ldan rta mgrin la sogs pa'i: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: gsang ba ye shes la sogs pa'i: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong srung ma ma lus dang: gter bdag rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog gtor: rol mo sbir: spyod lam ni thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang las: las rnams bskyang bar bya'o: bsngo ba ni: ho: dus gsum tshogs gnyis las byung dge ba rnams: dmigs med ye grol chos dbyings klong du bsngo: bdag gis dge rtsa bla med 'di byas pas: khams gsum rigs drug sems can ma lus kun: bde chen lhun grub zhing du sangs rgyas te: 'bras bu sku lnga myur du thob par shog: e ma bdag 'dra shel dkar mtsho sgron la: khyad 'phags rgya mtsho'i zab chos bla med gnang: lan gsum lung zhus yi ge'i ris su btab: nor 'khrul gab sbas med par bdag gis bsgrigs: 'di la rgyun du lag len 'bad gyur na: 'bras bu sku gsum tshe gcig thob pa dang: 'gro ba sgrol ba'i gru bo che ru 'gyur: go sla khyer bde 'di 'dra gzhan na med: zab pa'i phyir na rin chen gter du sbas: skal ldan las can snying gi bu mchog gcig: phyi ma'i dus su phyogs 'dir 'byung ngam sems: de yi gdul bya bod khams kun la 'byung: skal ldan skyes mchog de dang 'di 'phrod shog: ྈྈྈྈ gter rgya: e ma jo sras snang ba gu yang ba/ khu ston rdo rje gling pa bdag gis ni/

o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i lung byon te/ glang lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum dgong mor/ las ldan slob ma bsod nams mgon po dang bsdongs te/ klu bdud dang gnam sman dkar mo gnas pa'i gnas/ um steng mtsho mo me long 'gram nas gdan drangs te/ sngan lung dang chu'i phu/ chos rdzong sgang du/ skal ldan gyi slob ma skyes mchog gser gling pas bskul te/ tshes bcu gcig la/ o rgyan bla dpe dkrug yig las dag par phab bo// o rgyan nyid kyis lung bstan 'dug pa'i phyir// shog ser bla dpe dang bcas pa lhag ma ma lus par gtad do// de yi dge bas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po'i zhing du grol bar gyur cig /rigs drug 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog cig /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
